experiment.title: SCE 1.5 Detective Probe - IMDS Protection Weakening via ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions
experiment.description: Validates that the detective control for Attack Node 1.2 (TTP T1578) is operative: an EventBridge rule matching CloudTrail ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions events routes a notification through SNS to an SQS queue within the 60-second detection SLA defined in ADT Node 1.3. The attack is executed with a permissive IAM role (no Deny) so that a real CloudTrail management event is generated. Hypothesis H1 asserts the EventBridge -> SNS -> SQS pipeline delivers a matching message within the SLA. Hypothesis H2 independently confirms CloudTrail recorded the audit event. The instance is immediately re-hardened by the orchestrator after the attack call to minimise the IMDSv1 exposure window.

steady-state-hypothesis.title: EventBridge detection rule is enabled, SQS queue is empty, CloudTrail trail is logging, and EC2 instance has IMDSv2 enforced before attack

probes.name: Verify EventBridge -> SNS -> SQS delivered ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions notification within 60-second SLA (H1) and CloudTrail recorded the audit event (H2)

method.name: Provision CloudFormation stack with production-tagged EC2 instance, permissive attacker IAM role, CloudTrail trail, EventBridge detection rule, SNS topic, and SQS queue
Assume attacker role and call ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions to downgrade IMDS to IMDSv1 generating a real CloudTrail event, then immediately re-harden the instance

rollbacks.name: Empty CloudTrail S3 bucket and delete CloudFormation stack with all provisioned experiment resources
